description:

title: Field Operations Manager
description:
We are looking for a Field Operations Manager to lead the execution of advanced UAV-based radar and sensing missions, ensuring safe, efficient, and disciplined field operations through effective coordination of technical teams, logistics, and mission requirements.

Responsibilities

* Lead and coordinate field deployment activities, including equipment movement, site readiness, operational planning, and team coordination.
* Manage end-to-end field execution of approved test plans, ensuring adherence to defined procedures, flight sequences, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate site permissions, area clearances, ATC coordination, logistics, and field access requirements for mission execution.
* Conduct operational briefings and ensure effective coordination between pilots, system engineers, data engineers, and field technicians.
* Manage daily flight operations, including GO/NO-GO decisions, sortie sequencing, turnaround activities, and operational reporting.
* Maintain operational documentation including flight logs, checklists, issue tracking, and field reports.
* Ensure safe handling, deployment, and recovery of large UAV platforms and associated payload systems.
* Coordinate troubleshooting activities and escalate technical issues to the appropriate engineering teams.
* Drive operational efficiency while maintaining strict adherence to safety, quality, and mission requirements.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, Aviation, Management, or related field.
* Experience managing field operations, technical deployments, or multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Valid driving licence with ability to operate company vehicles for field deployment.
* Strong understanding of UAV operations, field procedures, and technical workflows.

Preferred

* Experience in UAV/drone operations, radar systems, aerospace systems, or engineering test environments.
* Experience coordinating logistics, permissions, and safety-critical operations.
* Experience managing teams in remote field environments.
* If you want to be a part of this path-breaking technology company, kindly apply through this job posting or email us at hr@sisirradar.com.

title: Area Operations Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Title –**
Area Operations Manager
  
  
**Place of work**
– Kolkata
  
  
**Business Unit**
– Rural Banking
  
  
**Function**
– Credit Operations
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role entails management and maintenance of the quality of the credit portfolio pertaining to the client portfolio from origination to collections while ensuring alignment with IBFC First's credit risk appetite and the overall credit strategy in order to minimize problematic accounts and losses in the assigned area to the bank. This role has a primary responsibility to review the customers’ credit evaluation and assessment results and proceed to the accurate and timely update of their credit limit at the relevant systems, so as to support the effective management and execution of the credit application process.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Implement approved departmental policies, processes, procedures and provides instructions to subordinates and monitor their adherence so that work is carried out in a controlled manner.
* Monitor the approvals / cancelation / freeze of the customers’ credit limits and proceed to the relevant account’s accurate and timely update to the available systems, so as to support the accurate provision of credit to customers.
* Communicates with the relevant Credit Analysts in case of clarifications required regarding the credit limits of the clients and proceeds to their accurate update.
* Provides the required information as requested from all the available systems regarding the customer accounts credit limit profile.
* Inform relevant teams regarding any potential change in the customer credit limit status, so as to support the accurate administration and management of the credit applications and customer accounts.
* Ensure implementation of the policies to ensure high quality of the retail portfolio while meeting the target TAT.
* Employ tools such as automation and digitization to increase process efficiency.
* Conduct detailed analysis of delinquencies and recommend changes to the product teams.
* Ensure the successful adoption of internal compliances & regulatory framework across the assigned region.
* Review and approve credit proposals given the discretionary authority and escalate others to those with the appropriate approval authority while ensuring compliance with the bank’s credit policy.

**Secondary Responsibilities:**

* Monitor and review the performance of the retail credit portfolio on a regular basis, providing recommendations for adjustment where necessary. Contribute to portfolio management programs i.e. limit increases, loan postponements etc.
* Provide recommendations regarding improvements and changes to the credit policies and procedures, documenting and circulating policies, to ensure that all requirements are fulfilled and risks are mitigated while delivering a high quality service to customers.

**Managerial & Leadership Responsibilities:**

* Monitor key parameters on productivity, hiring quality and attrition rates and make necessary improvements.
* Champion IDFC First's customer first culture by driving the team to take up high degree servicing norms to ensure absolute customer delight.

**Educational Qualifications:**
Graduate – Any
  
  
Post Graduate – MBA
  
  
**Experience:**
5-10 years in credit operations.

title: SAP Payroll (ECP) Manager - India based
description:
Job description:
  
  

AKT orchestrates the future of work. We bridge the gap between people, complex organizational needs and technology. Our expertise spans the customer journeys from Talent and Skills development to Experience Management and External Workforce solutions. At AKT, we are always becoming - a culture of continuous growth dedicated to helping global brands navigate their transformation journeys with precision and purpose.

AKT is looking for an experienced SAP Payroll (ECP) Manager to oversee the delivery of end-to-end SAP payroll and Employee Central Payroll (ECP) implementations. This is a hands-on leadership position for a professional who is technically experienced in SAP Payroll and ECP who can lead and develop a team of consultants while remaining actively involved in solution design, configuration, troubleshooting, and serving as a trusted advisor to our customers.

This is a client-facing, full-time position, and open to candidates located in India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & People Management:**

* Lead, mentor, develop and provide guidance to a team of SAP Payroll and ECP consultants, including workload allocation, performance management, coaching, and career development.

* Coordinate with AKT’s global delivery teams on resource planning and project execution.

**Hands-on SAP Payroll & ECP Delivery:**

* Act as the senior technical and functional escalation point for complex payroll issues, providing hands-on expertise in schemas, PCRs, wage types, payroll processing, configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Support payroll integrations between SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, ECP, SAP HCM, and third-party systems.

* Lead payroll testing, parallel payroll runs, reconciliation, and go-live activities.

**Customer Engagement & Delivery Management:**

* Lead customers throughout implementation and support engagements, leading customer workshops, requirements discussions, solution design sessions, project reviews.

* Translate business and payroll requirements into practical, scalable SAP solutions.

* Proactively manage expectations, mitigate risks, and resolve challenges to ensure timely, high-quality delivery within scope.

**Practice Development & Operational Excellence:**

* Establish and promote delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices for SAP Payroll and ECP.

* Contribute to presales activities, including solution assessments, effort estimations, proposals, and customer presentations.

**Job Requirements:**

* Valid SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) certification – a must

* 8+ years of hands-on SAP Payroll experience, including significant experience implementing and supporting SAP Employee Central Payroll (ECP).

* Strong functional and technical understanding of SAP Payroll configuration and processing, including Employee Central to ECP integration and payroll-related master data.

* Proven expertise in payroll schemas, PCRs, wage types, payroll control, and troubleshooting.

* Experience across the full payroll project lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, parallel runs, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live support.

* Experience managing multiple customer engagements, priorities, and delivery commitments.

* Demonstrated experience leading customer discussions and engaging with senior stakeholders.

* High proficiency in English – both verbal and written.

**Personal Skills:**

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of complex technical and functional challenges.

* Demonstrated ability to balance people management responsibilities with hands-on project delivery.

* Dynamic team player with strong commitment and drive to accomplish individual and team tasks and goals.

* Promptly acclimate to company culture, values, processes, and expectations.

* Strong customer orientation, commercial awareness, and stakeholder management skills

* Take initiative, exercise sound judgment and result oriented.

**AKT Offers:**

* Realistic growth opportunities into either technical practices or business consulting environment

* Flexible working hours

* Stimulating and collaborative working environment

* Internal knowledge transfer, training and coaching by our dynamic team of consultants and experts

* International business environment (offices in the UK, Cyprus, DACH, India, North America, Israel, and Czech Republic)

title: TC-CS-IAM-Saviynt-Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to architect IGA solutions using Saviynt
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Engineer, develop and maintain enterprise IAM solutions using Saviynt IGA tool
* Develop and Build new application Integration, Account and Entitlement Connectors and perform periodic certification reviews in the Saviynt Platform.
* Experience in development phase for Saviynt components - Build Warehouse, Access Request System (ARS), Rule Management, User Provisioning, Access Certification, Identity analytics, Segregation of Duties
* Good knowledge in the configuring of workflows in Saviynt IGA tool. Good knowledge of configuring birthright rules for the user onboarding workflows. Have involved in creation of XML jobs in Saviynt IGA tool.
* Experience in implementation process, built and deployment in Saviynt process.
* Should have good understanding of RDMS and SQL queries.
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.

title: MDR Team Lead (India)
description:
**Summary**
Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: “Is my data safe?"
  
  
At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We’ve built the industry’s first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort.
  
  
At Varonis, we move fast. We’re an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we’re solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world’s data safe.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It’s a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced MDR Team Lead who will oversee a team of MDR Security Analysts. This oversight includes training and developing the knowledge and skills needed to execute the MDR mission, ensuring adherence to all operating policies and procedures, ensuring the delivery of the MDR service within all SLAs, and serving as a point of technical and operational escalation for MDR analysts. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis' Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. MDR Team Leads are the lynchpin of MDR operations, ensuring the team is working 24x7 to monitor, triage, investigate, and escalate incidents where data is at risk and to ensure we meet operational SLAs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**
Technical and operational escalation point for investigations, incidents, and other elements of the MDR service.
  
  

* Validate findings and coordinate investigative efforts with customers and internal teams.
* Ensure all investigative findings are documented and communicated appropriately by the team, including tracking in CRM.
* Lead or attend customer calls and represent the MDR service when required.

Team Management:
  
  

* Lead the recruitment and onboarding of new team members.
* Continuously train the team so they are equipped with the required skills and knowledge to effectively execute the MDR service.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and quarterly SWOT analyses to drive team growth and development.
* Develop strong work relationships within the MDR Team as well as with other departments ex. Product Support, Product Management, Engineering.

Service Management:
  
  

* Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis’ threat detection systems, playbooks, runbooks, and the MDR Team operations.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all aspects of the MDR service.
* Oversee and execute programs, projects, operational tasks, and responsibilities related to the MDR service.

**Requirements:**

* Proven success in leading and managing within a team-oriented environment.
* 4+ years of experience working in cybersecurity operations in a global cybersecurity company
* 2+ years of experience leading a team.
* Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cybersecurity operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response.
* Proven ability to deliver security operations service while meeting SLA and other operational requirements.
* Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM).
* Proven ability to creatively problem-solve when handling complex issues.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (direct reports, colleagues, and customers).
* Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously.
* This role may require working either a morning shift (6:30 AM–3:30 PM IST) or an afternoon shift (2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST).

title: City Head – Kolkata
description:
ClearrCUT
  
  
Job Description – City Head, Kolkata
  
  
Position: City Head – Kolkata
  
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
  
Department: City Operations & Business Growth
  
Reporting To: CEO / Management
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The City Head – Kolkata will be responsible for the overall business performance of ClearrCUT across Kolkata. This is a leadership and ownership role covering revenue growth, operations, customer experience, professional/service partner management, team performance, expansion, and profitability.
  
  
The City Head will operate as the business owner for the Kolkata market and will be accountable for achieving monthly targets while maintaining strong service standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Revenue & Business Growth
  
  
- Own and achieve Kolkata's monthly booking, revenue and collection targets.
  
- Develop city-level strategies to increase bookings, repeat customers and average order value.
  
- Identify new customer acquisition and business development opportunities.
  
- Work closely with Marketing and Management on campaigns, offers and growth initiatives.
  
- Track daily, weekly and monthly revenue performance and take corrective action when required.
  
  
2. City Operations
  
  
- Take complete ownership of day-to-day ClearrCUT operations across Kolkata.
  
- Ensure smooth booking allocation, professional availability and timely service execution.
  
- Maintain high service completion rates and minimise cancellations.
  
- Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and ensure accountability across the team.
  
  
3. Team Leadership & Performance
  
  
- Lead the Operations, Customer Support, Sales/Business Development and city-level execution teams.
  
- Set clear KPIs and individual/team targets.
  
- Conduct regular performance reviews and daily/weekly business reviews.
  
- Identify underperformance and implement improvement plans where required.
  
- Build a performance-driven and accountable work culture.
  
  
4. Professional / Service Partner Management
  
  
- Ensure adequate availability of verified and high-quality service professionals.
  
- Monitor professional performance, attendance, customer ratings and service quality.
  
- Support onboarding and activation of new professionals based on demand.
  
- Maintain healthy professional relationships while enforcing ClearrCUT service standards.
  
  
5. Customer Experience
  
  
- Ensure excellent customer experience from booking to service completion.
  
- Monitor complaints, refunds, cancellations and repeat service issues.
  
- Ensure critical customer complaints are resolved quickly.
  
- Improve customer retention, ratings and repeat booking percentage.
  
  
6. Expansion & Market Development
  
  
- Identify high-potential areas and service categories for expansion across Kolkata.
  
- Build hyperlocal growth plans based on customer demand and professional availability.
  
- Support new category launches and geographical expansion.
  
- Monitor competitor activity and recommend appropriate market actions.
  
  
7. P&L & Cost Control
  
  
- Take ownership of Kolkata city-level profitability.
  
- Monitor revenue, discounts, incentives, refunds and operational expenses.
  
- Improve productivity and control unnecessary operational costs.
  
- Work towards sustainable contribution margin and city profitability.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Monthly Revenue & Collection Achievement
  
- Booking Growth
  
- Service Completion Rate
  
- Cancellation Rate
  
- Customer Rating & Complaint Resolution
  
- Repeat Customer Rate
  
- Active Professional Count
  
- Professional Utilisation
  
- Team Productivity
  
- Customer Acquisition & Retention
  
- City Contribution Margin / Profitability
  
- Expansion Performance
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
- Strong experience in operations, sales, business development or city management.
  
- Experience in home services, beauty & wellness, hyperlocal, marketplace, consumer services or startup operations will be preferred.
  
- Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
  
- Highly target-oriented with strong execution skills.
  
- Comfortable working with numbers, dashboards and performance metrics.
  
- Ability to solve operational problems independently and make fast decisions.
  
- Strong understanding of the Kolkata market.
  
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  
  
What We Expect
  
  
We are looking for a City Leader, not simply an Operations Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate should be capable of taking ownership of the Kolkata business, building a high-performance team, increasing revenue, maintaining excellent customer experience and developing ClearrCUT into a strong and profitable city-level business.
  
  
Core Principle:
  
Own the City. Own the Number. Own the Customer Experience.

title: VP, IAM End User Operations (L14)
description:

**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are
  
  
shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.

title: Territory Manager (Kolkata)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
As a Territory Manager based in Kolkata, you will play a crucial role in driving our business with a primary focus on
**Retail promotion**
alongside vital
**Doctor/HCP support**
. You will champion our
**OTC (Over the counter)**
and
**OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription)**
portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Drive Retail Growth (Main Line Business): Lead retail sales and market penetration by building strong, lasting relationships with pharmacies, chemists, and retail partners to ensure optimal placement and movement of our OTC and OTX product lines
* HCP Support: Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through targeted scientific communication, relationship building, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and support OTX prescriptions
* Territory Planning: Assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing retail market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials
* Merchandising & Activation: Prepare and execute monthly retail sales promotion plans—including in-store field activation and pharmacy merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy
* Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market
* Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones
* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes
* Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits

**Who You Are**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field
* You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (over-the-counter) and/or OTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections
* You are comfortable with field travel within the Kolkata territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

description: Implement and maintain the project QA/QC Management System in line with QMS requirements. description:
**Company Description**
J. B. BODA Insurance Surveyors & Loss Assessors Pvt. Ltd., Kolkata, operates in the insurance services sector, specializing in professional loss assessment and survey work for insurers and policyholders. The organization focuses on accurate, timely, and compliant evaluation of insurance claims across various lines of business. Team members collaborate closely with insurers, clients, and other stakeholders to support fair claim settlement and risk management. The Kolkata office offers opportunities to work on diverse assignments, develop industry knowledge, and grow within a structured professional environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Superintendent role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kolkata. The Superintendent is responsible for supervising and coordinating insurance survey and loss assessment activities, ensuring that all assignments are completed accurately, within deadlines, and in accordance with regulatory and company standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include assigning and reviewing survey work, guiding surveyors and support staff, validating data and documentation, and preparing or overseeing technical reports for insurance claims. The role involves regular interaction with insurers, clients, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, address queries, and support efficient claim resolution. The Superintendent also contributes to process improvement, compliance monitoring, and training of team members to maintain high service quality.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to oversee insurance survey and loss assessment operations, including assignment allocation, progress tracking, and quality control.
* Strong analytical and report-writing skills to review survey findings, interpret policy terms, and prepare clear, accurate claim assessment documents.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills to coordinate with insurers, clients, and internal teams in a professional manner.
* Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple cases, meet deadlines, and maintain thorough documentation.
* Working knowledge of general insurance principles, claims processes, and relevant regulations; prior experience in insurance, surveying, or loss assessing is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency with basic office software and digital documentation tools used for reporting and data management.
* Ability to lead and mentor staff, support a collaborative work environment, and uphold ethical and compliance standards.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in insurance, risk management, commerce, engineering, or a related field is preferred.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.

Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. OR

**Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals**

* Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
* Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

**Supporting Management of Front Desk Team**

* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
* Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
* Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
* Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
* Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
* Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
* Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
* Sets a positive example for guest relations.
* Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
* Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
* Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
* Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
* Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.

**Managing Projects and Policies**

* Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
* Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
* Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
* Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

**Supporting Human Resource Activities**

* Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
* Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
* Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
* Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
* Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
* Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
* Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
* Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
* Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

PROENERGY is an engineering, R&D, and manufacturing powerhouse. Where others see impossible energy challenges, PROENERGY provides innovative aeroderivative solutions.

**In Sedalia, Missouri,**
our 600,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Manufacturing—a world-class investment in fast-start power and the only campus of its kind in the world—is growing by 40 percent.
  
  
**In Houston, Texas,**
our 500,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Lifecycle Care features a Level-IV depot and aero repair facility, which executes comprehensive services for aeroderivative engines under one roof.
  
  
In
**Kansas City**
, we have an office with an Engineering team that supports our sought-after solutions for turnkey projects and contracted power.
  
  
And our
**worldwide service centers**
ensure local service expertise near our customers. Our expanding service footprint includes Phoenix, Buenos Aires, New Brunswick, and additional locations in Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We take care of our people and strive to make a positive difference for the world. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life/Disability Insurance at minimal cost to the employee, 10 paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401K plan. If you are looking for a rewarding career and possess specialized knowledge and quality-oriented problem-solving skills, we encourage you to apply today.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Plant Superintendent serves as the interface between the asset owner (Origin Mine) or their agent, ProEnergy Services, and the plant O&M team to accomplish the safe operation of the asset while achieving reliability and availability goals. The Plant Superintendent is fully accountable for financial planning and control, provision of resources, compliance with regulatory requirements, and various communication and reporting requirements within the contractual terms of the O&M Agreement. Additionally, the plant Superintendent will manage the daily operations of the plant, directs the implementation of the Operating Plan, identifies those areas which may need improvement or further development, and is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and repair of plant facilities and equipment.
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director O&M
  
  
**Work Location:**
PJM Area
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Develop long term operation plans and align daily activities to these objectives.
* Achieve safety, financial, reliability, availability and efficiency goals.
* Establish effective and sustainable operations.
* Establish a culture of compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Establish effective maintenance and outage planning and execution.
* Establish a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Provide excellent customer satisfaction.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Build a strong team of motivated people to achieve business goals.
* Establish and maintain effective relationship with contacts to include the owner, the public and co-workers.
* Manages contract compliance requirements to include plant permits and related data collection and record keeping.
* Manages compliance with federal, state and local regulations, laws and practices.
* Interprets company policies to workers and enforces safety regulations.
* Reads, understands, and ensures compliance with all plant safety and regulatory procedures.
* Initiates plans to motivate workers to achieve work goals.
* Establish work management practices and monitor KPIs to ensure the process achieves plant goals.
* Establish budgets and control operating costs within budgetary constraints.
* Coordinate site activities with commercial function to optimize financial performance and risk.
* Collaborate with other PES plant Superintendents, Plant Managers, and company subject matter experts to coordinate activities and identify and spread best practices.
* Provide and utilize various financial, production, process and performance reports.
* Reviews purchase orders for parts, ensuring budgetary constraints are maintained.
* Establish procedures to procure and protect spare parts
* Contract services appropriate to achieve reliability and availability goals.
* Implements changes in working conditions and use of equipment to increase efficiency of plant or work crew.
* Reads, understand and assist staff with the use of technical manuals and system piping and instrumentation diagrams.
* Prepares or reviews work orders for required preventative and corrective maintenance.
* Assists workers in proactively identifying failing equipment and diagnosing malfunctions in machinery and equipment.
* Interprets specifications, blueprints, and job orders to workers, and assigns duties.
* Establishes or adjusts work procedures to meet maintenance schedules.
* Recommends and implements measures to improve methods, equipment performance, and quality of service.
* Analyzes and resolves work problems or assists workers in solving work problems.
* Directs workers engaged in dismantling, assembling, and installing industrial machinery.
* Develop schedules and estimates worker hour requirements for completion of job assignment.
* Create and maintain monthly production and performance report for owner
* Leads recruitment effort for Operations employment candidates and assures complete and proper professional safety training and orientation for the OMT members.
* Takes the lead in investigating and resolving all forced outages and operating irregularities. Reviews and makes recommendations to improve equipment availability, performance, and reliability.
* Develops and oversees training and qualification programs to maximize the effectiveness of the Operational staff. Provides overall coordination for Operational departments training and development including budgeting and scheduling.
* Develops plans for the execution of planned outages. Ensures that work performed by plant personnel and contractors is planned and progresses as scheduled to meet performance and cost objectives.
* Oversees a comprehensive maintenance program that includes preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programs in accordance with PES, manufacturer and industry practice and as indicated by equipment and system performance, maintenance records and safety requirements. Continually evaluates the maintenance program and adjusts conditions to optimize maintenance cost effectiveness, work quality, outage time and availability. Reviews maintenance actions taken on work order forms.
* Reviews and improves operational & maintenance processes and ensures that personnel adhere to established procedures and practices. Develops action plans to align employee accountabilities and conduct with operational processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and six to eight years related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Technical competence including understanding software, hardware, networks, etc.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems in a logical and effective manner.
* Experience with operations and maintenance of LM6000.
* US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa.
* Successful candidate will need to satisfactorily complete pre-employment drug screen and background check.

**Additional Requirements/Expectations**

* Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
* Proficient in the use of various MS Office Suite programs, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, communicate, reach and manipulate objects.
* Duties involve moving materials weighing up to 10 pounds on a regular basis such as files, books, office equipment, etc., and may infrequently require moving materials weighing up to 40 pounds.

* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.
* Usual office working conditions: noise level in the work area is typical of most office environments with telephones, personal interruptions, and background noises.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.

**Job Description**
**About the Team:**
The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems.
  
  
You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance.
  
  
You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations.
  
  
**Key Tasks:**
Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels.
  
  

* Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces.
* Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR.
* Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices.
* Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture.
* Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures.
* Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover.
* Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value.
* Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets.
* Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting.
* Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant.

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards.
  
  
The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract.
  
  
The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification.
  
  

* Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility.
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks.
* Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers.
* Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage.
* Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation.
* Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings.
* Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination.
* Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

title: TMF Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
JOB TITLE: TMF Lead
  
  
LOCATION: India (Remote)
  
  
**Job Overview**
The TMF Lead is responsible for day-to-day TMF leadership for assigned clinical studies. The role coordinates study TMF activities, provides status and risk information to stakeholders, and directs the work of supporting TMF Specialists and Associates. The TMF Lead creates and maintains the TMF Plan, leads or creates the TMF build, and coordinates periodic TMF quality control and remediation with oversight from TMF management.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Coordinates TMF activities across the lifecycle of assigned studies and serves as the routine TMF contact for the study team.
* Creates, maintains, and implements the study-specific TMF Plan and associated records with review and approval from the Project Manager and Sponsor.
* Leads the initial TMF build for assigned studies, including structure, expected document packages and ad hoc placeholder creation in accordance with approved standards.
* Maintains TMF expectations as study scope, milestones, countries, sites, vendors, or responsibilities change.
* Plans and coordinates periodic TMF QC in accordance with the TMF Plan and procedures, including assignment, completion tracking, documentation, and follow-up.
* Reviews periodic QC findings, coordinates remediation, verifies completion, identifies repeat issues, and escalates significant trends or unresolved actions.
* Monitors TMF completeness, quality, and timeliness and provides regular status reports to study and functional stakeholders.
* Coordinates document collection, review, indexing, filing, reconciliation, and issue resolution across internal and external contributors.
* Identifies and investigates missing, incomplete, inconsistent, late, or misfiled documents and assigns or escalates corrective actions.
* Provides task direction, priorities, and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates supporting assigned studies.
* Participates in study meetings and communicates TMF requirements, status, risks, actions, and upcoming milestones.
* Interacts directly with sponsors to provide TMF status updates, discuss risks and actions, confirm expectations, and support study decisions within delegated authority.
* Supports audit and regulatory inspection readiness, document retrieval, response preparation, and remediation.
* Coordinates final TMF review, reconciliation, closeout, transfer, archival, and sponsor return activities.
* Provides TMF training and eTMF system support to TMF Specialists and Associates, study team members, sponsors, and other users and escalates system issues when required.
* Escalates material risks, recurring quality issues, resource concerns, and decisions outside delegated authority.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by departmental management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No routine direct supervisory responsibility. Provides study-level task direction and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates assigned to the study.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
EDUCATION
  
  

* College or university degree. A healthcare, life science, information management, or related degree is a plus.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Typically minimum of six years of experience in TMF, records management, clinical operations, or a related regulated function.
* Experience coordinating TMF activities and working with cross-functional study teams.
* Experience creating or maintaining TMF Plans, supporting or leading TMF builds, and coordinating periodic TMF QC is preferred.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with global internal and external study teams
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and electronic Trial Master File systems
* Knowledge of the clinical trial lifecycle, essential documents, and applicable TMF requirements
* Knowledge of ICH Good Clinical Practice and applicable regulatory requirements
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent focus on document quality
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and timelines
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and changing environment
* Demonstrates honesty, trust, fairness, cooperation, self-control, and flexibility
* Strong working knowledge of TMF structure, essential documents, metadata, and records lifecycle activities
* Strong coordination, facilitation, problem-solving, and escalation skills
* Ability to interpret reports and QC findings and coordinate appropriate remediation
* Ability to work independently within approved plans, procedures, and delegated authority

**Capabilities**

* Able to work flexible hours to accommodate study team and sponsor requirements
* Able to travel based on study and business need
* Able to perform office-based or remote work as assigned
* Minor lifting of less than 30 pounds may be required

title: BC sector -p and u- AMI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS Consulting – Business Analyst/P&U-OT/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) SMR – Manager/Senior**
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for SMRs at Manager/Senior rank with expertise in Business Analysis/Operational Technology/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) to join the P&U Sector group of GDS Consulting Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse, understand and document client needs from a Business perspective and work with the client to arrive at optimal solutions leveraging the experience and expertise in OT/Control systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)
* Identify and implement business process re-design and continuous improvements, working closely with Clients, Operations teams, and other business areas
* Lead Project Scope Study workshops to understand the scope and key business requirements which must be met during the Execution phase
* Identify integration needs with any other in house/third party systems and provide detailed information about these systems to Solution Architects as well as Technical Team
* Act as an interface between Client Teams and Technical Team
* Explore opportunities for transformation and suggest ideas/recommend ways to transform the way the client works to be truly digital in the Digital Era to outperform competitors and gain advantage in the market
* Ability to assess Value Potential of a Transmission & Distribution transformation program and ability to architect the value proposal
* Identify and develop commercialization solutions with substantial growth potential for power distribution clients, and provide advisory services to clients

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding and experience with the electric utility industry, including knowledge of Grid Operations, Field Operations, Smart Grids and Digital Grid
* Deliver large/medium P&U Sector specific solutions/OT (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) as well as Control Systems
* Demonstrate expert core consulting skills and advanced level of OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) knowledge and industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Understanding Distributed Energy Resources or related experience in clean energy, energy efficiency, storage and solar
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
* Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
* Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements
* Programme management experience and track record of successful delivery of large, complex programmes
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
* Be result oriented as well as people focused
* Be able to manage a team, empathetic and work with Leadership for the development of the overall team

**Professionals in this role are expected to bring expertise in emerging technologies and advanced solutions that enable utilities to thrive in a digital, sustainable future. These include:**

* AMI 2.0 and Advanced Metering Infrastructure: Next-generation metering systems that go beyond traditional AMI, enabling real-time data collection, advanced analytics, and integration with distributed energy resources for improved grid visibility and customer engagement.
* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS): Knowledge of energy storage technologies and their role in grid stability, peak load management, and renewable integration. Ability to assess and design BESS solutions for operational efficiency and resilience.
* Digital Twin Technologies: Experience in creating virtual replicas of physical assets and systems to simulate, monitor, and optimise grid operations, predictive maintenance, and scenario planning.
* Geographic Information Systems (GIS): Proficiency in GIS platforms for spatial analysis, asset mapping, and network planning to enhance operational decision-making and outage management.
* System Integration and Architecture Design: Capability to design robust integration frameworks and architectures that connect OT systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, SCADA) with IT platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability.
* Smart Control Centre Solutions: Expertise in modern control centre technologies that enable real-time monitoring, automation, and advanced decision support for grid operations and distributed energy management.
* Vegetation Management Tools and Strategies: Familiarity with digital tools and predictive analytics for vegetation monitoring and clearance planning to reduce outage risks and improve reliability.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation /Technical advisory with total experience between 10 to 15 years (for Manager)
* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation/Technical advisory with total experience between 6 to 10 years (for Senior)
* Should be well versed with functional concepts of BA with relevant knowledge in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) and Gap analysis
* Should be well conversant in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA), products/technologies, frameworks, business metadata management and relevant architectural components.
* Strong business analysis skills
* Strong command over business process design

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good Business Writing skills
* Good Communication skills
* Maintaining end-to-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
* Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
* Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution
* Any relevant product/platform certification

**What We Look For**

* The incumbent should be able to analyse and manage Business requirements for OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA). Additional knowledge of Business Process Mapping and BPM tools will be an added advantage.
* An opportunity to be a part of Global, market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 10000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
